reason: The reviewer identifies the exact same mechanism as ground truth: the .first() call on the Flow<ProgramState?> returned by programStateRepo.observe() is never invoked, so initialState is bound to the non-null Flow object itself rather than its emitted value. Both state this makes `initialState == null` always false, forcing startDestination to always resolve to TopLevelRoute.Main, and both identify the runtime consequence as onboarding never being shown to brand-new users. This is a precise paraphrase of the same defect, not a different bug or vague complaint.
